title: Microsoft Learning Zone: lesson-level insights on where a class struggles and each student's answers
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned lesson insights improvement, education licensing and organisation-wide access control. It distinguishes the app's documented default availability from the improved reports' unstated rollout behaviour, and appropriately flags the remaining control and access questions.

claims.quote: Microsoft Learning Zone is available to organizations with a Microsoft 365 Education A1, A3, or A5 license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing: Licence
claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the eligible education licence for this improvement to Learning Zone reports.
claims.quote: Microsoft Learning Zone is available to organizations with a Microsoft 365 Education A1, A3, or A5 license. ... There's no additional cost for Learning Zone when it's used with an eligible education license.

claims.where: front matter: cost, licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learning Zone has no additional cost with an eligible education licence, supporting cost none.
claims.quote: There's no additional cost for Learning Zone when it's used with an eligible education license. Institutions can adopt the app without separate procurement and keep administrative control over its availability.

claims.where: summary; front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence or price specific to the improved lesson insights is published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" reports licensing price meter administrator co-teachers'; '"Learning Zone" "lesson" "insights"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone, including licensing and account requirements; no insights-specific licence or price found.

claims.claim: No meter is documented for Learning Zone reports.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" reports licensing price meter administrator co-teachers'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; it states no additional cost with an eligible education licence and documents no reports meter.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Devices; Scope: Platforms
claims.claim: Educators can use Learning Zone and view reports on Windows 11 PCs.
claims.quote: All other Learning Zone capabilities, including editing, assigning, teaching, and sharing lessons, viewing reports, and using the ready-to-learn lesson library, are available on any Windows 11 PC.

claims.claim: The documented slide limit concerns lesson generation, not viewing reports.
claims.quote: On other Windows 11 PCs, each generation is limited to 10 slides. ... All other Learning Zone capabilities, including ... viewing reports ... are available on any Windows 11 PC.

claims.claim: Learning Zone itself is available to everyone in eligible organisations by default unless an administrator turns it off.
claims.quote: Starting January 1, 2026, Microsoft Learning Zone is available to everyone in eligible organizations by default, unless an administrator turns it off.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The improved insights' default state is unknown: Microsoft has not said whether they automatically replace current reports or need a setting.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "insights" "automatically"'; '"Learning Zone" "lesson insights" "settings"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone and the roadmap record; neither states the improved reports' default or an enabling requirement.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the improved lesson insights.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "lesson" "insights"'; '"Learning Zone" "lesson insights" "settings"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; it describes built-in reports, not the roadmap's improved lesson insights.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics for the improved reports are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "insights" "automatically"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone and roadmap record 577544; neither specifies staged versus simultaneous rollout of the improved insights.

claims.claim: The Learning Zone admin page requires sign-in with an administrator account.
claims.quote: Go to the Learning Zone admin page at https://aka.ms/LearningZoneAdmin and sign in with an administrator account.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not name a specific administrator role for the Learning Zone admin page.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "administrator" "role"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone, including Turn off Microsoft Learning Zone for your organization; it specifies an administrator account but no named role.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The organisation access control is under Access settings on the Learning Zone admin page at aka.ms/LearningZoneAdmin.
claims.quote: Go to the Learning Zone admin page at https://aka.ms/LearningZoneAdmin and sign in with an administrator account. ... Under Access settings, turn off access to Learning Zone.

claims.where: controls[0].governs, scope, note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: The access setting turns off the whole Learning Zone app for the organisation, rather than only its reports.
claims.quote: IT administrators can turn off Microsoft Learning Zone for their organization: ... Under Access settings, turn off access to Learning Zone.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or Microsoft Graph equivalent for the Learning Zone access setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "Access settings" "Graph" "PowerShell"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; the relevant result documents only the admin-page operation and no automation equivalent.

claims.where: controls[1].ui, api, note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate UI or API setting for lesson insights or the per-student answer view is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "lesson insights" "settings"'; '"Learning Zone" "Access settings" "Graph" "PowerShell"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; no separate reports or student-answer control found.

claims.claim: Learning Zone user data is stored in the European Union, the United States or Australia.
claims.quote: User data collected through Microsoft Learning Zone is stored in the European Union, the United States, or Australia, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable regulations.

claims.claim: Some AI processing for lesson generation might occur in a different geography from data storage.
claims.quote: Some AI processing for lesson generation might take place in a different geography from where your data is stored.

claims.claim: Learning Zone uses Microsoft 365 Education sign-in.
claims.quote: When you open Microsoft Learning Zone for the first time, sign in with your Microsoft 365 Education account, the same account you use for Microsoft 365 or Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Learning Zone applies the institution's policies to access, content creation and sharing.
claims.quote: After you sign in, Learning Zone recognizes your organization and applies your institution's policies to your access, content creation, and sharing options.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described who besides the assigning educator can see answers in the improved insights.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "reports" "co-teachers"'; '"Learning Zone" "lesson" "insights"'. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone and roadmap record; no improved-insights permissions for additional educators found.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity, Autonomy & actions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The sources describe a reporting improvement, not changes to learner behaviour, identity or autonomous actions.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Zone" "lesson" "insights"'; '"Learning Zone" "insights" "automatically"'. Read roadmap record and Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; neither describes such additional changes for this improvement.

claims.claim: The Learn deployment page links a Learning Zone data collection article.
claims.quote: For information about the types of data that Microsoft Learning Zone collects, see Data collection in Microsoft Learning Zone.

controlChecks.governs: Whether Learning Zone, and so its lesson insights, is available to the organisation
